t: 托马斯·华纳爵士在圣基茨岛发现了加勒比海上的第一个英国殖民地.
te: Sir Thomas Warner founds the first British colony in the Caribbean, on the island of Saint Kitts.
dz: 托马斯·华纳爵士在圣基茨岛发现了加勒比海上的第一个英国殖民地.
de: Sir Thomas Warner founds the first British colony in the Caribbean, on the island of Saint Kitts.

t: 法国和荷兰签署《贡比涅条约》.
te: Signing of the Treaty of Compiègne between France and the Netherlands.
dz: 法国和荷兰签署《贡比涅条约》.
de: Signing of the Treaty of Compiègne between France and the Netherlands.

t: 查尔斯·德·拉·维尤维尔被逮捕并被红衣主教里切留接任为法国国王的首席顾问.
te: Charles de La Vieuville is arrested and replaced by Cardinal Richelieu as the French king's chief advisor.
dz: 查尔斯·德·拉·维尤维尔被逮捕并被红衣主教里切留接任为法国国王的首席顾问.
de: Charles de La Vieuville is arrested and replaced by Cardinal Richelieu as the French king's chief advisor.

t: 法国国王路易十三任命红衣主教黎塞留为首相。
te: The French king Louis XIII appoints Cardinal Richelieu as prime minister.
dz: 法国国王路易十三任命红衣主教黎塞留为首相。
de: The French king Louis XIII appoints Cardinal Richelieu as prime minister.
